tooltipLines.leftText: Use: Take a sip of the drink you swiped from the freight, increasing your Critical Strike by 572 for 15 sec. (1 |4Min:Min; 30 |4Sec:Sec; Cooldown)

Equip: Your damaging abilities have a chance to echo with Xathuux's furious roar, increasing your Critical Strike by 160 for 30 sec.

During this time, each of your attacks increases your Critical Strike by an additional 21, stacking up to a maximum of 5 times.

Use: Form a Fel Shield for 10 sec, absorbing 30% of incoming damage, up to 196,649. While the shield holds, a portion of the absorbed damage is stored as volatile Fel energy.

When the shield expires or breaks, the energy erupts and inflicts Fire damage to split between nearby enemies. (1 |4Min:Min; 30 |4Sec:Sec; Cooldown)
Use: Unleash the fel energy stored within the crystal, sacrificing 13,438 of your health to infuse a target ally for 10 sec, absorbing 461,359 damage. (1 |4Min:Min; 30 |4Sec:Sec; Cooldown)

(2) Set: Every 30 seconds during combat, you capitalize on your next critical strike to gain the Upper Hand. Every situation is different, as is your Upper Hand at the time. Healing tonics, poisoned daggers, and other magical contraband are all on the table.
